tool.description: Convert a color between formats. Accepts #hex (3/4/6/8 digits), rgb()/rgba(), or hsl()/hsla(), and returns the equivalent hex, rgb, rgba, hsl, hsv, and cmyk representations plus the alpha. Runs locally.

color.description: A color in any common notation: #hex (3/4/6/8 digits), rgb()/rgba(), or hsl()/hsla().
